prompt: Announce the First Baptist church potluck as a WWE ring announcer. Full commitment.
response:
*[Spotlight hits center stage. Smoke machines billow. Pyro erupts from the corners of the Fellowship Hall. A titantron graphic of a rotating green bean casserole with flames shoots across the big screen.]*

**ANNOUNCER:**  
LADIES AND GENTLEMEN, BOYS AND GIRLS, CHILDREN OF ALL AGES… AND ESPECIALLY CHILDREN OF THE MOST HIGH GOD…  
THE TIME HAS COME… FOR THE ULTIMATE COVERED-DISH COLLISION COURSE!  
THIS… IS… **POTLUCK!**

*[Air horns blare. A stained glass window graphic shatters.]*

**ANNOUNCER:**  
WE ARE *LIVE*, FROM THE FELLOWSHIP HALL OF **FIRST BAPTIST CHURCH**, WHERE THE CARPET IS GOLD, THE TEA IS SWEET, AND THE MACARONI IS ALWAYS BAKED, BROTHER!

THIS SUNDAY! SUNDAY! SUNDAY!  
FOLLOWING THE CONCLUSION OF OUR 11 O’CLOCK WORSHIP HOUR—AND AFTER PASTOR JIM DELIVERS WHAT PROMISES TO BE A SLAMDUNK SERMON FROM THE BOOK OF ACTS—WE’RE GATHERIN’ AT THE TABLES FOR THE MOST HOLY OF HOLY BUFFETS!

AND LET ME TELL YOU, THE CARD IS STACKED!

IN THE FIRST CORNER… WEIGHING IN AT A COMBINED 14 POUNDS OF PULLED PORK AND SWEET BABY RAY’S… THE “TENNESSEE TORNADO,” THE “PORK PROPHET” HIMSELF… **DEEEEACON DAAAAAVE!**

*[Deacon Dave rips off his “Usher Team Captain” polo to reveal a sleeveless BBQ-sauce-stained shirt. He flexes a spatula.]*

AND HIS OPPONENT… COMING OUT OF THE KITCHEN WITH A DISH SO CREAMY, SO DECADENT, IT SHOULD BE TITHED… THE “QUEEN OF CASSEROLE,” THE “MONARCH OF MUSHROOM SOUP,” THE ONE, THE ONLY… **MAAAARTHA “THE GREEN BEAN MACHINE” MITCHELL!**

*[Martha waves a oven-mitted hand. The crowd loses their sanctified minds.]*

BUT THAT’S NOT ALL! WE HAVE A TRIPLE-THREAT AMBROSIA SALAD MATCH! A DEVILED EGG TABLES MATCH WHERE THE ONLY RULE IS, “THOU SHALT NOT DOUBLE-DIP”! AND IN THE MAIN EVENT… FOR THE UNDISPUTED HEAVYWEIGHT DESSERT CHAMPIONSHIP OF THE WORLD… BERTHA’S BANANA PUDDING VERSUS THE UNDERTAKER’S… wait, no, SISTER GERTRUDE’S SEVEN-LAYER CHOCOLATE APOCALYPSE!

SO BRING YOUR CASSEROLES, YOUR CROCKPOTS, AND YOUR CHURCH COOKBOOKS! BECAUSE WHEN THAT FINAL BELL RINGS AND THE PASTOR SAYS THE BLESSING, ONLY ONE THING IS FOR CERTAIN…

*[Leans into the microphone, voice dropping to a gravelly whisper.]*

…THERE’S GONNA BE A CLEAN-UP CREW OF TWO OR THREE GATHERED IN THE KITCHEN, AND THEIR NAMES ARE ALREADY ON THE SIGN-UP SHEET.

CAN I GET A HALLELUJAH?!

CAN I GET AN **AMEN?!**

AND CAN I GET A… **POTLUCK?!**

*[“Jesus Take the Wheel” by Carrie Underwood blasts over the speakers as the Deacons set up the folding chairs.]*
